note.en: Representative ideal MHD with magnetic permeability set to one. E is total thermal, kinetic and magnetic energy density. Follow CT/GLM, divergence conventions and HLLD tests.

note.en: [0,1], initial jump x=0.5, t=0.1. HLLD/MC/SSPRK2 is compared after conservative block averaging of the 512-cell result; this same-solver numerical reference is not an exact MHD solution.

method_note.en: Methods from explicitly bound supplementary examples and, where present, the common execution example. No release for a different problem is borrowed.

name.ja: Brio–Wu：HLLDと保存的に粗視化した数値参照
name.en: Brio–Wu: HLLD and a conservatively restricted numerical reference

scope.ja: γ=2、Bx=0.75の1次元理想MHD衝撃波管をt=0.1まで計算。HLLD＋MC＋SSPRK2の64/128セルを512セルの数値参照と比較し、密度・圧力・縦磁場・保存収支・切替回数を記録する。
scope.en: Evolve the one-dimensional γ=2 ideal-MHD shock tube with Bx=0.75 to t=0.1. Compare 64/128-cell HLLD/MC/SSPRK2 with a 512-cell numerical reference, recording density, pressure, longitudinal field, balances and fallback counts.

assumptions.ja: μ0=1、左右(ρ,vx,vy,vz,p,Bx,By,Bz)=(1,0,0,0,1,0.75,1,0)/(0.125,0,0,0,0.1,0.75,−1,0)。初期不連続x=0.5をセル界面へ合わせる。既存solve_1dの固定定義とJSONの一致を検査し、変更した物理定義は拒否。CFL=0.35。
assumptions.en: μ0=1, with left/right (ρ,vx,vy,vz,p,Bx,By,Bz)=(1,0,0,0,1,0.75,1,0)/(0.125,0,0,0,0.1,0.75,−1,0). The initial jump x=0.5 is face-aligned. JSON must match the unchanged solve_1d benchmark definition; altered physical definitions are rejected. CFL=0.35.

limits.ja: 512セル参照も同一solverで、厳密解・独立コード・MHD弱解の一意性の証明ではない。密度差0.03は左密度1に対する3%の平均絶対差を許す教材基準。正値性再試行とHLLE切替は数えるが、再構成の正値スケーリングの作動数は既存APIにない。正値出力だけから一般の保証やゼロ修正を主張しない。
limits.en: The 512-cell reference uses the same solver and is neither exact nor independent, nor a proof of uniqueness of MHD weak solutions. Density difference 0.03 allows a mean absolute discrepancy of 3% of left density 1 for this educational test. Positivity retries and HLLE fallbacks are counted; reconstruction positivity-scaling activations are not exposed by the existing API. Positive output alone certifies neither general positivity nor absence of reconstruction changes.

reference_note.ja: 512セルの保存変数を64/128セルへ整数ブロック平均し、その後にprimitive変数へ変換する。CSVは128セルごとに計算値とそのセル平均に対応する参照値を配置。正値性、縦磁場10^-12、境界流束収支10^-10、経験的な誤差減少を別々に判定し、fallback回数を隠さない。
reference_note.en: Restrict the 512-cell conserved variables by integer block averaging to 64/128 cells before converting to primitives. CSV pairs each 128-cell result with its corresponding restricted reference. Positivity, longitudinal-field error 10^-12, boundary-flux balance 10^-10 and empirical error decrease are separate checks; fallback counts remain visible.

description.ja: 512セルの保存変数を64/128セルへ整数ブロック平均し、その後にprimitive変数へ変換する。CSVは128セルごとに計算値とそのセル平均に対応する参照値を配置。正値性、縦磁場10^-12、境界流束収支10^-10、経験的な誤差減少を別々に判定し、fallback回数を隠さない。
description.en: Restrict the 512-cell conserved variables by integer block averaging to 64/128 cells before converting to primitives. CSV pairs each 128-cell result with its corresponding restricted reference. Positivity, longitudinal-field error 10^-12, boundary-flux balance 10^-10 and empirical error decrease are separate checks; fallback counts remain visible.

name.en: Brio–Wu against an independent HLLD implementation

scope.ja: 公開HLLD-MC有限体積コードを、固定コミットから別に構築したAthena++のBrio–Wu参照と比較します。
scope.en: Compare the published HLLD-MC finite-volume code with Brio–Wu reference data independently produced by Athena++ at a pinned commit.

assumptions.en: 1D, [0,1], t=0.1, gamma=2, Bx=0.75; left/right (rho,p,By)=(1,1,1)/(0.125,0.1,-1), zero velocity, outflow boundaries.

limits.ja: Brio–Wuの複合波を含む数値解との照合であり、一般MHD Riemann問題の唯一の厳密解とは呼びません。参照の再生成にはC++コンパイルが必要で、通常Python実行は同梱参照を使います。
limits.en: This compares numerical solutions including the Brio–Wu compound wave; it is not a claim of a unique exact solution for arbitrary MHD Riemann problems. Reference regeneration requires C++ compilation; routine Python runs use the stored reference.

reference_note.ja: 128/256/512セルを、2048/4096セルで再実行した独立参照の保存的細胞平均と比較。rho/ByのL1誤差、格子改善、密度・圧力正値性を判定します。
reference_note.en: Compare 128/256/512 cells with conservative averages of independently rerun 2048/4096-cell references. Check density/By L1 errors, refinement and positive density/pressure.
